purpose: gamepipe1: Nord2Metal y2s86-gamepipe = y2s83-thumbfix5 + (1) every process: a slow commit (over RWM_SLOW_MS, default 6 ms) gets a 'GP slow commit anatomy' line: wall vs this thread's CPU time, process pageins/faults/cow/csw/mach syscalls/msgs during it, verdict COMPUTING/WAITING; (2) third-party apps only (bundle id not com.apple.*): render pipelines are keyed by SHA-256 of both AIR modules + names + shape + function constants and a repeated one reuses the compiled library ('GP pso reused', 'GP pso ... summary'); (3) same apps: newRenderPipelineStateWithDescriptor:...completionHandler: built on a serial utility queue. Switch /var/db/nord2-metal/no-gamepipe = thumbfix5 behaviour. Not over photosperf1/usecount (sibling Nord2Metal builds).
kernel_image: any kernel (userland only); the phone's current image
